image_description: A domestic interior scene featuring two large, white bookcases filled with books. Two black cats are sitting inside the bottom shelves of the respective bookcases. The background wall is covered in framed pictures and posters. A striped rug is visible on the floor in the foreground.

artifact_observations.location: Right bookcase bottom shelf / Cat integration

The frames on the wall have slightly inconsistent perspective lines relative to the room's geometry, appearing somewhat warped or non-planar.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the black cats and the bookcase shadows. AI often struggles with dark-on-dark contrast, leading to limb fusion or loss of definition. Verify if the 'books' have any legible text or if they are just textured blocks.
